note: Yosemite Valley's largest campground and its only one open all year, under pines near Curry Village on the free shuttle route. Paved spurs; most sites take an RV of 24 ft or more, though not every site fits the posted maximums. Free dump station with water; pay showers at Curry Village. Sells out within minutes of each monthly release. May close at short notice for high winds or heavy snow. --Claude
